summary: Both prior defects confirmed fixed: Okutan 2024 [4] carries the correct 8-author list (Okutan S, Jørgensen NT, Pedersen LE, Borresen SW, Hilsted L, Hansen LF, Feldt-Rasmussen U, Klose M) and ref [5] (urmc.rochester.edu) is fully removed with no residual inline citation. All inline cites use [N, tag] format with no bare [N]; all tags are within the 12-enum; all hosts are whitelisted (endocrine.org Tier 2, oup.com/springer.com via Bornstein/Okutan journals); unit conversions (×27.6) are internally consistent across all paired values; DST/ACTH-stim/salivary thresholds are correctly attributed to Nieman 2008 and Bornstein 2016 with the LC-MS/MS assay-shift caveat grounded in Okutan 2024.
